label: Oncology: several causes incl. biological
design: every distinct oncology stop-reason text (all phases and study types) that classifier 2.7.5 with the reviewed index labels biological (a biological failure, or several causes including a biological one), not in oncology-2026-11 or oncology-bio-2026-11 and not a held-out validation text. Makes up for a build_batch bug that left texts with several causes out of oncology-bio-2026-11. Confirm mode, about one label in twenty deliberately wrong.
